overall.summary: Helios documents a clear, self-service, single-patient CSV-in-zip export path with 15 typed section schemas, but the model is highly flattened and likely incomplete for full designated-record-set EHI coverage, especially outside summary clinical slices.

notableFacts: The public b(10) PDF explicitly states export is launched from Encounter Summary and is permission-gated by system administrators.
Each selected category generates an independent CSV file and the system downloads a zip bundle.
The schema documents 15 export sections and 71 datatype-bearing field rows.
Most sections are highly compressed (often Id plus one varchar field), with no documented inter-file relationships.
No sample export payloads or machine-readable schema artifacts were included in the reviewed files.
A Provenance section exists (AuthorTimeStamp, AuthorOrganization), but this is limited metadata rather than full audit logging.
